t: A kingdom founded by Afonso Henriques in 1139 whose border with Castile, fixed in 1297, is among the oldest in Europe.
Its navigators reached India by sea in 1498 and Brazil in 1500, creating an empire of trading posts and colonies.
After union with Spain (1580–1640), loss of Brazil and civil war, the monarchy was overthrown by a revolution in 1910.
dyk: Between 1808 and 1821 Rio de Janeiro was the seat of the Portuguese monarchy, the only time a European kingdom was ruled from one of its colonies.
ev: Afonso Henriques begins to style himself king after the Battle of Ourique
Afonso I takes Lisbon with the help of crusaders
Afonso III completes the conquest of the Algarve
John I defeats Castile at the Battle of Aljubarrota
Vasco da Gama reaches Calicut in India by sea
Philip II of Spain becomes king, beginning the Iberian Union
A revolt restores independence under John IV of Braganza
A revolution on 5 October ends the monarchy

f.capital: Coimbra; Lisbon from the mid-13th century (Rio de Janeiro 1808–1821)
